nodes.natural_language: Minimizer of sum w_i |x-a_i| is weighted median of points {1/k} with weights k
nodes.statement: minimizer is weighted median of {1/k} w.r.t. weights k

nodes.natural_language: At the minimizer x=1/85, kx\le1 for all k\le85 and kx\ge1 for all k\ge85, so f(1/85)=\sum_{k=1}^{84}(1-k/85)+\sum_{k=85}^{119}(k/85-1)
The total weight is \sum_{k=1}^{119}k=7140, so a weighted median occurs where the cumulative weight on each side is at least 3570.
nodes.statement: total weight 7140 so weighted median has cum. weight \ge3570 on each side
